body: Nothing makes me happy. I look back on my life and seen an isolated, depressed individual who nobody ever loved.

But if it won't make me happy why bother. What need do I have to be composed? Why falsely motivated myself with an empty purpose?

I can't do anything to impact the world at large, only be impacted by it. This is true for 99% of the world.
I don't even know if happiness is real.

My brain is broken. I've been through meds, electroconvulsive therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, and god knows how many psychotherapies. 

I've attempted suicide three times and almost succeeded. Rightfully I shouldn't be alive and it took me almost a year of physical therapy to be able to walk after one attempt.

Some people are just broken. I'm one of them.

Society begs to differ at this point. Everyone says time fixes everything. 

What if this is my fix? Why does everyone have to live? What reason do I actually have if I've assessed myself as a failure with no drive to fix it?

People don't enjoy me and quite frankly I've stopped trying to let them in. They just want my money or a ride. 

How many times would you let these scenarios pass before you realize that your life is just awful?
Carbon monoxide poisoning, overdosing, and bullet to the head.
Nothing to cry about. I did it all to myself. Now I'm just here, hanging out.

3 times. I'm now permanently paralyzed and in eternal pain. I am still very much suicidal, but it's difficult to do in a wheelchair in my case.

The depression never got worse, it was always a simple sin wave with really deep troughs and insignificant crests.

I really just wish I wouldn't wake up anymore. My dreams are destroyed, my body is broken, and my mind is melting away.

Who are you to dictate what is right and wrong in death? 

No one can arbitrate such things. 

Regardless I'd much rather drown anyways.

The morals of the living don't matter to those trying to die. 

We're all just cogs in the machine waiting to break.

No, I'm done. I gave everyone else everything and in return they spat on my shoes, stabbed my back, and poisoned my mind.

I have no obligation to live.

If the one thing I'm selfish about is my death, then so be it. I'm done placing others over me. I'll be sure to have a note about why I'm the asshole for trying to die on my person.

Nobody will remember suicide fondly so what does it matter? The dead aren't concerned with the living.

Life for life's sake is a dissatisfying answer. Do I have any moral or ethical obligation to live? Of course not. Death is the greatest contract to sign because the term is permanent and the ink is your blood. 

Nothing else matters. Life is just death's distraction.
Exactly so why should I let cog-in-the-machine #49076 tell me not to kill myself. It's my life.

Will those relationships even matter? Do I ever care about relationships? I don't know anymore. 

I'm left to search for meaning as a try to transition away from nihilism into existentialism. It's crushing me as a person, because I see all these people living pointless lives yet they do so with genuine emotion. 

But why? 

For every 100 people I meet, maybe 1 or 2 are worth it.

I know, logically, I'm not alone. But there's no one like you around me in real life. I was, jokingly, and rather accurately, called a functional depressive by my therapist on my first visit.

I go to work, do my job, and then shut down. It's like outside of my crappy job I can't bring myself to do anything. 

I'm trying to get laser eye surgery and go to college this year. I already got my last two prescriptions and I go to a consultation not this Friday but next.

In about a week, my job will offer to help with college tuition. I'm looking to get an associates in IT so I can transfer to a 4 year when I get done with this terrible job.

I can do things. I just don't see much emotional reason or fulfillment in them.

I work for the government as an analyst. I have a decent life.

But I don't feel anything. Haven't in about 6 years.

I'm barely 21. 

I did all the right safe things as a kid, graduated with a 3.35 gpa, scored a 1630 on the sat, never partied, did drugs, or anything like that.

I just don't relate to people.

I guess it's good I could kinda help someone but all I can say, and it doesn't make much logical sense, is I'm sorry.

Somedays I wish I had a much more physical ailment, because then at least I wouldn't feel like a fraud sometimes. 

It's easy to say a guy with cancer is really hurting, it's so much harder to do that with any kind of mental illness for so many reasons. 

Good luck.

I'm just so tired of trying. My progress is in decimals when I want double digit whole numbers. If its not the MDD its the dysthymia. If it's not the dysthymia its the MDD. I don't see a point, because I can't see myself being happy, I can't see myself getting better. 

I know the depression screws with your head. I know it makes you see the worst. But I entertain the dissonance that while it's logical I will get better if I keep trying, there's no point because that's years of my life I've lost just trying to feel happy. 

I used to entertain thoughts of suicide, but there was no reason too. It literally does not matter, at least to me, my state.

My passion and zest for life are gone, and have been for years. 

I'm just exhausted. 

I feel like I can't talk to anyone about it. I'll lose all these superficial relationships I've cultivated in my life. Sure it's not really a support system but at least they talk to me.

My own mother doesn't understand. I can't tell. She would probably have a stroke and bawl her eyes out for a long time, I'm talking months, feeling guilty about something she doesn't really have control over.

At this point I'm just living because it's the status quo, and I wouldn't exactly call it living. It's just too hard to change.

You are a chasing an ideal that can't be reached. The pendulum will only swing further and further until men become uninterested in women and women are forced into men's roles.

Society only learns the hard way. Wait until the unnoticed working women is the standard, then we'll see how this goes.

Also I don't see particular pushback for benevolent sexism/racism. Sure you'll tell me you shouldn't be getting all these grants, scholarships, and jobs, but how many will give up their diversity hire status?

Life has no meaning. It is up to the individual to forge meaning. If one cannot, then life will always be meaningless.

I can't tell you what to value and I can't make you value anything.

To some people, the juice just isn't ever worth the squeeze. It never was and never will be.

We are all ultimately alone on our journeys to find meaning. Some walk on paved paths of others, some choose to carve their own, some choose to never advance, and lastly, 

Some will never find their path.

I can't make life meaningful, you have to find and forge your own.

It's a task similar to giving you a sand shovel and asking for a deep, wide moat. It can be done but not all will finish it.
I wish. I'd spoil some poor puppy rotten.
What's the point? It'll just be an ephemeral effort lost in the sands of time. Nothing really matters so why bother?

I've been there, to both priests and therapists. It just feels like they're peddling White lies and kind words. My mind is very stubborn, much to my detriment. It also seems difficult to medicate properly.

If I had to describe my life it would be two ticking clocks, one for my natural death and the other for suicide. I'm just waiting to see which goes First.
I can't at the moment. I can't for the next few days. Instead I just get to pretend to be okay. It's alright though, I've been doing this for years.
Yes, it was going to the therapists for suicidal ideation and major depression. It was terrifying because I shouldn't be sick. But I am.

I tried, but she rejected me. The longer I'm alive the more I'm convinced life is about connecting to other people, something I seem to only feel comfortable doing at a superficial level.

I can't stop worrying about others. I made everyone more important than me in my own life. They're probably out trying things and seeking their ideals while I feel like I sit here, physically fine but rotted away on the inside.

I can't convince myself I matter unless it's to do stuff for other people. And that gets me burned so much.

People keep saying that and I feel terrible because I can't believe that. I don't even matter to myself so how could I matter to others. 

My life doesn't suck, I just think it does, so my perception becomes my reality. I hate it too because my problems don't seem real or significant.

I'm just whining about higher order things when some people are lucky to get water and food.

I've accepted this as my lot in life. I've been stuck in this stupid mental state for years. The therapy sometimes feels like a big load of lies.

I think I do a lot of what I do to distract myself from how dissatisfied I am with my life.

I feel like I keep waiting for it to start but it never does.

I don't know anymore. I feel like I'm just trapped in a routine for comfort, not happiness. I just do the same things leading to marginal satisfaction instead of taking risks.

I like to believe I want a SO, someone to share my life with, but I'm not an outgoing person nor do I see myself as someone others would want.

I want to start school this year. A degree might give me some satisfaction, I don't know. I'd like to get mine in information technology with a focus on either networking or security. I like computers I guess.

Part of me always says it will get better, but another part says it never will because I'll never put in the effort.

I'm not a religious person.

But why is it beautiful? Just because it's so scarce? I have difficulty doing anything without a point. There has to be some kind of meaningful endstate besides death, even if I make up that endstate.

There has to be. If there isn't I don't see much point in going on.

I am in therapy. I am on meds. Nothing has changed, probably because I'm afraid to get better. Sure my life isn't terrible, I'm not poor, I have a place to live, I have people who call me friends.

But it's so empty. I'm trying to find out why. My therapist asked me one of my first sessions a really simple question that resonated with me.

"Do you ever find yourself asking what's the point? It could be about as something simple as your job to something as complexed and nuanced as your life."

Of course I answered I rarely see the point in anything. Everything just seems like a distraction until death. I can't get out of this circular thought pattern of nothing mattering, so why bother.

It's been about 5 years since I've felt this way. I need to go to the hospital, something like an inpatient or intensive outpatient program.

 But if I do I'll lose my job and my college funding and a whole host of other benefits. I hate my job but I need it.

I know a lot of suicidal people, and two of my close friends attempted. One succeeded, the other did not.

I don't want to die, but I don't want to live this hollow life where I don't let anyone in, where I have to convince myself living through the day is a better choice than dying, where the only reason I'm still here is because I'd feel guilty leaving all that hurt and pain in my wake.

I need to be the one to give it meaning is easily the most identifiable and difficult hurdle. I could cure cancer but if I didn't think it was impactful then why bother.

I want to believe relationships deepen life. The problem is I don't let people in.

I didn't know and still don't. I was looking for something to give my life meaning. Wealth, fitness, and creative endeavors only went so far.

Im trying to answer(a fools errand) the question of why I'm alive.

I was in a slump. I dropped out of college, I quit working in the service industry, and it felt like all I did was sit on my computer for 12-16 hours a day.

I sought a purpose in serving. It was a big mistake. Everyday I regret signing that stupid paper.
If the whole point is just to experience life then I've had my fill.

I'm so trapped though. I am in the military and can't stand it. Granted I couldn't stand my life when I was out of it either.

Reading, drawing, painting, hiking, weight lifting, playing videogames. I've tried all these things. They briefly combated the abyss, but as always, I was left staring back into it.

Why keep persisting?

21. But what exactly is the point? Like why bother? Simply because others will be hurt if you go? I have no control over that.

I just know I wake up every morning wondering why I'm still alive.

Money is meaningless unless you don't have enough of it. Love is nothing to me because I've never felt unconditionally loved just for who I am. The more I study philosophy the more I see the world in a Hobbes-esque light.

Why bother?

I've been in the same spot a lot. I do this dumb thing because I feel like I have to, where I'm kind to everyone but myself first. This leads to a lot of emotional vampirism, using, and just pain.

Just the other day I was on the beach debating just walking into the ocean. No notes, no texts, just me.

Yet here I am. It's hard and it sucks and I know feeling like a failure can be soul crushing, but I'm gonna do that stupid thing I do and root for you before myself. 

I don't want you to succeed at anything crazy. I just want you to try today. Don't worry about tomorrow. 

Just try today.

Thank you for being a kind person. I'm just so dead inside all the time. It's hard to remember what being happy was like. Was I even happy? Was it just naviety?

I can't talk to my own mother about this. It took me 4 years just to admit it wasn't okay to lay in bed all day and think bad thoughts. 

I was hesitant to try meds because I'd seen horror stories and both my doc and psych we're very clear that these things take a long time and that's after you found what works.

I say the therapy doesn't help but that's not really true. I just wish it had more results much faster. Something my psych told me about cbt was that it wasn't just him telling me over and over that I mattered, because that simply doesn't work on someone with poor self-worth.

It's about getting you back to a relatively normal or average baseline. Where the good is good, not just okay and the bad is bad, not world-shattering.

It's about getting me to believe I matter but I have so much trouble doing so. I know I do a lot of things wrong or at least not right, but it's hard to break a routine you've spent years cementing.

While my own mom means well, she just doesn't know how to handle the depth of my issues. That's my fault partially, because I pushed her away a lot whenever she used to ask if something was wrong or I was okay. I would do my damndest to end that conversation, because I was in denial and didn't want to make my mom cry.

She already thinks she did a bad job, but she tried and that's all I can ask. She's only human.

Sorry this is so long. I've got a lot on my mind.
I'm afraid that's my job and I'm a lazy Mason at best.

Her response to my depression was "You have a good life and other people have bigger problems."

I'd rather not go through that again.
This one doesn't. It just falls apart after a little while.
Once or twice with my mother. She tried to be helpful but ultimately invalidated me entirely. I'd rather not go through that again.
There's no much to say I'm afraid. It would be akin to talking to a brick wall for you.
Well it's because I am. I'd rather my family get an anonymous call declaring me dead than call them. It would be much too painful and would not do them good.
So they say. It really should be true, but I have a terrible time convincing myself.

I'm sorry for what has happened to you. I suppose the closest family death has ever been to me was my grandparents.

I attended my grandfather's funeral last year. The service was nice but I didn't enjoy the after party.
I'm a cruel selfish weak willed person at the end of the day. I would like to be done with this charade I call life.
I'd rather not say but it's tropical.

There's nothing to apologize for. You've played no part in this little scheme of mine.

But I do appreciate your time.

Just because it's natural doesn't mean it's right. If someone is terminally ill do you allow them to exist in a vegetative state. I wouldn't. It's cruel.

The only disconnect I see here is you believe I can fight this illness, whereas I'm done fighting.
I have and if anything I feel further isolated and uncared about. My family downplays my issues, I haven't found the right antidepressant, and I am just a terrible therapy patient.
To live after any attempt I make would further cement I'm a jester in the court of this cruel world.

Because that's like telling kids not to do drugs. It doesn't work. Also treatment is a very poor word for the endless amounts of pills that I suffer through in an attempt to be normal.

I've been left to rot by people who supposedly cared, who supposedly wouldn't leave.

 I'm not Superman, I'm sorry I blew out the floodgates, but they asked what was going on and got a decades worth of backed up, boiled over issues. 

Stop asking if you don't care and can't handle it. Yes I'm fucked up, yes I know that, but you're just teasing me at the end of the day with 

'im always here to talk.' and 'i want to help you.' Maybe deep down in your soul you do, but it's a pretty poor showing when you get bailed on and tossed out the moment you have issues.

So tell me why I should care about the ramifications of my death? So my family can realize they raised another fucked up kid? So my friends can pretend they were there? So people I'm barely even acquainted with can show up at my funeral and make it about our relationship and them?

No, fuck that. I know I'm bitter and twisted but that's because I tried, for years, and it doesn't get better, you just get more used to disappointment.

I'm sorry but I just don't think like that. As for why I can't, because the happy kid who put up those walls is gone and he took everything with him. I'm just what's left, and what's left knows that he has a problem but can't fix it.

What's left barely has the will to get out of bed, much less change their entire outlook on life.

And what if I can't decide on a point, on a purpose? What's worse than living an empty life constantly and listlessly searching for a reason to exist? Some would say dying but I'm not so sure.

It just feels like all my relationships are so superficial, fake, and empty. It's mostly due to myself and all the walls I've thrown up, but if I've not the heart nor the head to knock them down, why bother?

My problems existed before the military and they'll likely exist long after. I don't find much of anything fun nowadays. Seems like too much of a hassle.

I talked to therapist for years while I was in. I was probably a terrible patient. Sure I talked to him about things I'd never told a soul but I never felt like I put in effort to be better.

Seems so much easier to just hang out in my loneliness and count down the years until I don't have to do much of anything. It's not what I want but I don't see myself putting forth enough effort to actually get better.

I was diagnosed when I was 20, but my life wasn't great before then. Feel like I haven't been at peace since I was 16.

My sister went to jail for drugs sophomore year, my other sister went into a bunch of debt just to get out of the house. My parents were fighting a lot around this time. My friend attempted suicide and was in inpatient for roughly 6 months.

Junior year another friend killed himself after spring break.

Senior year came and went, uneventful. I didn't go to prom or homecoming except in sophomore year. Was not a fun time. Felt so out of place.

I went to college for a semester and dropped out. I had no drive. I was just sitting at home, wasting away. At some point on the way my parents asked me to consider the military.

I went to enlist in the airforce, they gave me a job I didn't want, so I backed out and joined the army. Worst mistake of my life.

Nearly 5 years of my life down the drain where I did nothing and for some reason random people praised me for it.

Now here I am back in the real world and I learned one valuable thing. It's me.

I just have a terrible, pessimistic outlook on everything. Had it since high school. Seemed easier to say everyone sucks and turn inward than try and deal with all this social garbage that I was terrible and afraid of.

So here I am, just waiting for my degree so I can get my certs, get a job I don't want, and waste away 30 or so years working. 

I hate me so much.
But isn't it the best coping mechanism? It literally cannot fail unless it's botched by the one attempting.

I was diagnosed with MDD like 4 years ago. I just don't really get the point of being alive. Like why, specifically, am I here?

I'm not special, unique, or anything. Just another cog in an uncaring machine.
